name: identity-fusion-records-customizer
description: Records Customizer for Identity Fusion NG

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'data'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });"
scripts.build:code: npx ncc build ./src/index.ts -o ./dist -m -C && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('data')) fs.cpSync('data', 'dist/data', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:records && npm run build:code
scripts.prepack-zip: npm run clean && npm run build
